value: Every posting names physics or natural sciences (Physik, Physiker, Naturwissenschaften) as an accepted degree, accepts a Bachelor, is not student or PhD, and links to the employer's own page. Experience and leadership demands are ignored for Production supervisor (you have that experience); elsewhere senior-only roles are left out. AI training means training or grading AI on physics and maths problems. Content creation excludes school teaching. Device testing & measurement means jobs whose main output is a measurement, test result, calibration or qualification of a device, or the rig that produces it.

Europe outside Germany. Every posting names physics or natural sciences as an accepted degree, accepts a Bachelor, is not student or PhD, links to the employer's own page, and is at an employer that hires internationals: the ad offers visa sponsorship, work-permit or relocation support, or the employer is on the country's official sponsor register (Netherlands IND, UK Home Office, Denmark SIRI, Ireland employment-permit list). The working language is English or German, or no local language is demanded at working level. Experience and leadership demands are ignored for Production supervisor; elsewhere senior-only roles are left out.
